name: Radio Group
summary: Jake UI labeled radio-option extension with selected/unselected and default/focused/disabled states.
description:
Jake UI labeled radio-option extension with selected/unselected and default/focused/disabled states. Exact source anatomy and examples are implemented by Radio Group / Indicator, Item, Root, and Field Composition.

Layout exception: the selected Radio Control overlays the inner selection dot within the outer control. This coordinate-based micro-geometry is intentional and excluded from structural auto-layout linting.

Pipeline API classification: apply the Governance property-classification rule before code mapping. Visual State axes are QA/story states unless engineering explicitly approves a controlled runtime prop; Viewport is responsive test data; Pattern is composition/story data.
dos: Reference variables for every value; never hardcode a hex or px.
Change state through props, never by detaching the instance.
Label the control itself, not only the group.
donts: Do not emit State as an enum prop. It packs states that co-occur at runtime.
Do not use a radio group for multi-select.
Do not use a toggle for choices that only apply after a separate Save.
whenToUse: Checkbox or toggle for an independent on/off value.
Radio for one-of-many within a group.
whenNotToUse: A single either/or action that takes effect immediately with no save — prefer a toggle over a checkbox.
A choice that only applies after a separate Save — prefer radio or checkbox over a toggle.

notes: State decomposition applies — see docs/state-decomposition.md. State [Default · Focused · Disabled] → :focus-visible CSS-owned, dropped; disabled independent boolean
State is exposed via aria-checked, never by colour alone.
keyboard: Radio groups move between options with arrow keys.

states.Value=Unselected, State=Default: gap space/2-5 · fill card · border stroke/1 input · text foreground · type Label/LG
states.Value=Unselected, State=Focused: gap space/2-5 · fill card · border stroke/2 ring · text foreground · type Label/LG
states.Value=Unselected, State=Disabled: gap space/2-5 · fill muted · border stroke/1 input · text muted-foreground · type Label/LG
states.Value=Selected, State=Default: gap space/2-5 · fill card · border stroke/1 primary · fill primary · text foreground · type Label/LG
states.Value=Selected, State=Focused: gap space/2-5 · fill card · border stroke/2 ring · fill primary · text foreground · type Label/LG
states.Value=Selected, State=Disabled: gap space/2-5 · fill muted · border stroke/1 primary · fill muted-foreground · text muted-foreground · type Label/LG
